summary: Added meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed; exact integer/Fraction arithmetic, no decimal context), moved every rounding and fixed-place format into it, removed the context line from __init__.py, and added tests/test_money.py. Batch pool threads used to round band charges and price per kWh half-even (fresh thread context) while bill/quote used half-up; this is kept via keyword-only method parameters. Other quirks kept: cash 'whole' never yields a negative zero. Differential runs against the original showed identical CLI output; only 28-digit-precision effects of implicit decimal arithmetic on absurdly long inputs are not reproduced.
